en: Vintage sepia portrait of a young woman in three-quarter profile, looking slightly upward. She has short wavy hair and wears a dress or blouse with a large, rounded white collar tied at the neck. The photo is bordered by a lightly scalloped edge typical of old photographic postcards. Beneath the image is printed text with the person's name and a small line of additional text in a lighter font at the lower right.
